_note: Set 2026-11-15 from D:/imagenet-filter/sheets/validation_*.jpg. Padding, the YOLO watermark cut (.25), text and logo keep the LAION values: on the sheets they catch frames, watermarks and date stamps, and pages of text. Three cuts are raised, because at the LAION values they caught ordinary ImageNet photographs: screenshot (.003 caught dashboards, monitors and dials; real screenshots start near .038), nsfw (.004 caught monkeys, babies and shoes; .019 to .03 is still mostly clothed people) and collage (.007 caught any two objects side by side; real collages are about a quarter of .015 to .022). The near-duplicate cosine is .98, not .95: at .95 the pairs were different photographs of one subject (19 of 20 on the sheet), and at .98 they are the same scene shot twice.
